recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It is a bounded correction to an active narrative source page and completes the published Jira resolution without expanding into unrelated extensibility guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-34212 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction. It requested that Patient Consent examples use the extension StructureDefinition canonical URL rather than registry-location URLs in the instance and referencing profile, and that Patient Consent and Patient Name Parts cardinalities 1..* and 0..* be expressed on the Extension root while simple extension value[x] remains 1..1.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied by c47042398891f647a92fd4feac6a06e260375892, which removed max='*' from Extension.value examples, and by 6f541c9ceb4d14e1794ea8945fe609fc6e495a09, which corrected the Patient instance URL. The current source still had the stale Patient profile canonical reference and lacked root-level extension cardinalities.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists extensibility-examples.html as an active child of the Extensibility page, confirming build scope. No relevant Zulip or Confluence records were found for FHIR-34212 or the key example terms, and no later Jira evidence was discovered that would reverse the Published/Persuasive resolution.
reconciliation: Edited source/extensibility-examples.html to use http://example.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/participation-agreement consistently in the Patient Consent registration prose and XML/JSON profile references, add 1..* to the Patient Consent Extension root, add 0..* to the Patient Name Parts Extension root, and make the Patient Name Parts value min 1 in both XML and JSON fragments.
source_changes: source/extensibility-examples.html: corrected the Patient Consent canonical URL in registration prose and XML/JSON profile examples.
source/extensibility-examples.html: added root-level 1..* cardinality for the Patient Consent Extension example while keeping Extension.valueUri min=1.
source/extensibility-examples.html: added root-level 0..* cardinality for the Patient Name Parts Extension example and changed its value min to 1 in XML/JSON fragments.
